summary: Independently validated the 12 acceptance criteria for the regenerated PulseFitness Sicon WebAPI Bruno collection + mapping artifacts. Ran both generators cleanly, inspected the .bru tree, CSV, MD, and both public download endpoints via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 20/22 assertions pass; 2 minor coverage gaps (Auth POST lacks WRITE-guard by design; Core/Ping GET lacks tests block).

minor.issue: Auth/Authenticate.bru is a POST but has no script:pre-request WRITE-guard. Criterion 6 says 'EVERY POST and PUT'. Likely intentional (bootstrapping auth), but worth documenting/whitelisting in the generator so strict readers don't flag it.

Core/Ping.bru is a GET but has no tests { } post-response assertion. Criterion 8 says GET requests include a test asserting status/properties. Add `tests { test('ping ok', () => expect(res.status).to.equal(200)) }` in build_bruno_collection.py.

action_items: In build_bruno_collection.py: add a `tests { ... }` block to Core/Ping.bru asserting res.status===200 (and optional server field).

In build_bruno_collection.py: decide whether Auth/Authenticate.bru should carry the WRITE_BLOCKED guard (recommend NO because you need it to enable writes) — instead, update acceptance criterion documentation to state 'every business POST/PUT' or add a small comment in the .bru explaining the intentional exemption.
critical_code_review_comments: Acceptance criterion 6 wording 'EVERY POST and PUT' technically covers Auth/Authenticate.bru; either add the guard (would deadlock: token needed to enable writes) or clarify wording to 'every business write'.
Ping GET has no response test — trivially fixable in the generator template.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_sicon_bruno_artifacts.py (new — reusable regression harness for the 12 acceptance items)
seed_data_creation: None. Artifacts regenerated in place via the two generator scripts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rerun `pytest backend/tests/test_sicon_bruno_artifacts.py` after the two minor fixes. The harness covers all 12 acceptance items: env companyId=2, Equipment reads + $skip/$max pagination, TrackingNote.appointmentId={{appointmentId}}, bru.setVar id-capture on 5 PostOne endpoints, no zero-reset in collection.bru, ALLOW_WRITES=false, WRITE-guard on POST/PUT (currently strict — excludes Auth), 13 Lookups GETs, GET response tests, null-vs-zero optional FKs, mapping.csv 8-col header + 164 rows + no UNMAPPED, FIELD_MAPPING.md format, and both download endpoints returning correct content-type & bundle contents.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is verification-only. Two minor generator gaps identified: (a) Core/Ping.bru template omits `tests {}` block; (b) Auth/Authenticate.bru intentionally omits the WRITE_BLOCKED guard but the acceptance wording 'every POST/PUT' does not exempt it. Both are template-level fixes in /app/integrations/build_bruno_collection.py.
